title: A role's filter on the many side doesn't hide rows of the one side

source.quote: Row filters use DAX expressions to define the rows in a table, and any related rows in the many direction, that a user can query.
source.supports: a filter reaches related rows in the many direction only

derivation: BigSales keeps the sales of 50 or more: 1 (100) and 3 (50), 150. Customer is on the one side of Sales, so its four rows stay.
